I have been farming this valley plot for many years. I will apply urea that I bought from the village agro-dealer, and I also have cow manure to mix into the soil before planting. My family will do most of the work, but during transplanting and harvesting I will need to hire some labor from the village because the work must be done quickly when the rains come. I use rice seed I kept from last season's SARO crop, and I do not use chemical sprays because they are costly and I prefer to pull weeds by hand.
